items.name: kan-theme
items.title: KAN theme
items.description: Stone palette (dark default, light via data-theme), Instrument Sans + IBM Plex Mono (+ Instrument Serif for editorial), KAN type scale, radii, motion and utilities, mapped onto the shadcn/ui variables.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Primary (one per view), secondary (default), ghost, danger and link.

items.name: input
items.title: Input and field
items.description: Text input with a mono overline label and a helper or error line.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: A tile for one number that matters, with delta and history bars.

items.name: status
items.title: Status
items.description: Status label (dot plus word) and one-line banner.

items.name: segmented
items.title: Segmented
items.description: Switch between 2–5 views or units. Always keeps one selection.

items.name: kan-logo
items.title: KAN logo
items.description: Wordmark and K icon as components that follow the theme (currentColor).

items.name: side-head
items.title: Side-head
items.description: Editorial section: the label in its own margin column. Portfolio and writing only.

items.name: nav-bar
items.title: Nav bar
items.description: Top navigation: logo, items with the square on the active one, actions, and a floating menu on mobile.

items.name: side-nav
items.title: Side nav
items.description: Vertical navigation for tools and docs. The active item gets the square.

items.name: toaster
items.title: Toaster
items.description: One-sentence toasts with a status square. Confirmations fade after 4 s; errors stay until dismissed.
